canonical_source.behavior: From the loaded Site Details workspace, the Settings control navigates to the selected site's settings while retaining the exact current site identity.

laravel_adaptation.adaptation_reason: Laravel uses the protected server-rendered canonical site-settings route; the site id is validated and derived from the selected route, the tenant slug comes solely from authoritative frontend context, and tenant-wide settings are separately permission-gated.

authorization.frontend_visibility: requires tenant.view and sites.view, or wildcard permission
authorization.missing_permission_semantics: 403 on the protected Site Details source route

tenant_isolation.proof: The canonical target resolves a tenant-scoped Site from the authenticated Laravel tenant context; the control rejects malformed/non-positive site ids and derives tenant identity only from trusted frontend context, while the server responds 404 for foreign tenant/site selectors.
tenant_isolation.caller_override_probe: Route identifiers containing traversal/query syntax are rejected and the control cannot accept a caller-supplied tenant override.

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and source metadata
same-tenant canonical site settings authorization and render

terminality.basis: Corrected site-scoped navigation targets the actual protected Laravel Site Settings controller; tenant-wide settings are a separately permission-gated destination.
